info.name: Greenhouse-Full-Demo
info.description:
Smart Greenhouse Controller - all scripts. Author: Role 5 - Timing & Integration Lead.
Start the system with run.bat, then run the whole collection (or one folder). Everything is automatic: inputs, waits, checks, repair. Watch the CLI for the system's reactions.

item.name: Watchdog: T3 FAILED, voter DEGRADED (after 3 s)

exec: // wait so the real-time system has time to react (no user action needed)
pm.test("T3 marked FAILED by watchdog", () => pm.expect(json.sensors.T3.health === "FAILED").to.be.true);
pm.test("RT3: detected within 2500 ms (+100 ms jitter tolerance)", () => pm.expect(json.detectionMs.T3 !== undefined && json.detectionMs.T3 <= 2600).to.be.true);

item.name: 03-Timing-And-Shutdown
item.description:
Owner: Role 5 - Timing & Integration Lead.
COMMON: timing analysis (max C, U = C/T, total U vs RM bound 0.757) and clean shutdown. Run LAST.

exec: // wait so the real-time system has time to react (no user action needed)

item.name: Timing report (also printed in the CLI)

exec: // wait so the real-time system has time to react (no user action needed)
pm.test("every task has run", () => pm.expect(json.tasks.every(r => r.runs > 0)).to.be.true);
pm.test("total U below the RM bound -> schedulable", () => pm.expect(json.totalUtilisation <= json.rmBound && json.schedulable === true).to.be.true);
console.log("Total U = " + json.totalUtilisation + "  RM bound = " + json.rmBound + "  -> " + (json.schedulable ? "SCHEDULABLE" : "NOT GUARANTEED"));
